headword: ブラック{企業|きぎょう}
gloss: exploitative company; sweatshop company; abusive employer

definitions.gloss: exploitative company; sweatshop company; abusive employer
definitions.explanation: A company notorious for overworking employees, paying inadequate wages (especially for overtime), engaging in harassment, or otherwise mistreating its workers. A widely used social term in contemporary Japan.

examples.japanese: ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}めている→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I work for an exploitative company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて⟦フリーランス→フリーランス：06152_furiiransu⟧になった。
examples.english: He quit an exploitative company and became a freelancer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{残業代|ざんぎょうだい}→残業代：10102_zangyoudai⟧⟦{未払|みばら}い→未払い：18029_mibarai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{典型|てんけい}→典型：03556_tenkei⟧だ。
examples.english: Long working hours and unpaid overtime are typical of exploitative companies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{就職活動|しゅうしょくかつどう}→就職活動：14840_shuushokukatsudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{口|くち}コミ→口コミ：17690_kuchikomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: During my job hunt, I researched online reviews to avoid exploitative companies.

notes:
A widely used contemporary term composed of the English loanword ⟦ブラック→ブラック：08787_burakku⟧ (black, used here metaphorically as "shady" or "bad") + ⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧ (company, enterprise). Coined in the 2000s, it became common in the 2010s alongside growing awareness of labor abuses, overwork, and death-by-overwork (⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧: to work at an exploitative company
- ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}める: to quit an exploitative company
- ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦{大賞|たいしょう}→大賞：12191_taishou⟧: "Black Company Grand Prize" (an annual naming-and-shaming award)
- ブラック{企業|きぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧: characteristics of a black company

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ホワイト⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧: white company — the opposite; a company with good working conditions
- ⟦ブラック→ブラック：08787_burakku⟧⟦バイト→バイト：06955_baito⟧: part-time job with exploitative conditions (especially targeting students)
- ⟦{過労死|かろうし}→過労死：14324_karoushi⟧: death from overwork — the extreme consequence associated with such companies

TYPICAL SIGNS:
Commonly cited signs of a ブラック{企業|きぎょう} include unpaid overtime (⟦サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}→サービス残業：08477_saabisuzangyou⟧), very high employee turnover, power harassment, and impossible quotas. The term carries strong negative connotations and is used both in casual complaints and in serious journalism.
